design_name: INT8 Systolic-Array GEMM Accelerator Tile (Tensor Core Tile)
design_purpose: One-line: A parameterizable NxN INT8 output-stationary systolic-array GEMM/MAC engine with weight buffer, activation input FIFO, 32-bit accumulators, a requantize-and-clip stage to INT8, and a control FSM with valid/ready streaming interfaces, representing a single fully-verifiable compute tile of a transformer QKV/FFN projection matmul (LLM inference bottleneck).
scope: The user asked for 'a chip to accelerate inference of a 7B-parameter LLM (e.g. Qwen-7B)'. A full 7B chip cannot be built/compiled/simulated in this environment. We scope to a REPRESENTATIVE, FULLY VERIFIABLE core compute subsystem: an INT8 systolic-array GEMM engine ('Tensor Core Tile') that captures the real bottleneck of LLM inference (matmul in attention QKV/FFN projections).

IN SCOPE: A parameterizable INT8 systolic-array style MAC/GEMM engine ('Tensor Core Tile'): NxN PE array (choose 8x8 PEs as default parameter) doing output-stationary INT8 multiply-accumulate with 32-bit accumulation, representing one tile of a transformer's QKV/FFN projection matmul.
IN SCOPE: Local weight buffer (SRAM/register-file model) and activation input buffer/FIFO feeding the array, with simple streaming load control (double-buffering optional).
IN SCOPE: Output accumulator array with a requantization/scale-and-clip stage down to INT8 (post-GEMM quantization).

IN SCOPE: A control FSM sequencing weight-load -> stream -> drain/output phases, plus a simple streaming register interface (valid/ready handshake) so a testbench can drive it like a real accelerator tile.
IN SCOPE: Basic top-level integration wiring these into one accelerator core module with a documented port list.
out_of_scope: Full 7B-parameter weight storage/HBM/DDR memory controller, tokenizer, embedding table, full multi-layer transformer datapath (28+ decoder layers), softmax/LayerNorm/RoPE full pipelines, multi-core NoC/mesh interconnect, floating point formats, PCIe/host interface, compiler/ISA/instruction decode.
Anything requiring commercial place-and-route/synthesis or real HBM/DDR PHY.
This is a single representative accelerator TILE/core, not the full chip. Make that explicit so nobody downstream claims '7B model verified.'

DESCOPED (RTL Director, this deliverable): Weight double-buffering (ENABLE_DOUBLE_BUFFER=1) behavior. The original user scope stated double-buffering was OPTIONAL ('double-buffering or simple streaming load control', 'double-buffering optional'). The shipped RTL implements SINGLE-BUFFER only, where LOAD_WEIGHTS and COMPUTE are mutually-exclusive FSM phases. ENABLE_DOUBLE_BUFFER=1 (load-next-while-compute) is OUT OF SCOPE / deferred for this deliverable; the parameter remains documented with default 0 (single buffer), which is the only supported mode shipped. See REQ-GEMM-020.

parameters.name: N
parameters.description: Systolic array dimension; NxN PE grid (default 8x8 = 64 PEs). Computes an NxK by KxN tile.

parameters.name: SCALE_W
parameters.description: Width of the requant multiplier (scale) input. Interpreted as UNSIGNED per resolved decision RESOLVED-006.

parameters.name: SHIFT_W
parameters.description: Width of the requant right-shift amount input (0..31).
parameters.constraints: design choice; supports shifts up to 31

parameters.name: WBUF_DEPTH
parameters.description: Weight buffer depth in INT8 entries = N*N (one weight per PE for output-stationary tile). Default 64 for N=8.

parameters.name: AFIFO_DEPTH
parameters.description: Activation input FIFO depth (in words). Design choice for streaming buffering.

parameters.name: ENABLE_DOUBLE_BUFFER
parameters.description: Weight-buffer buffering mode. Default 0 = SINGLE buffer = the ONLY supported mode in this deliverable (LOAD_WEIGHTS and COMPUTE are mutually exclusive). The 1 = double-buffer (load next weight set while current tile computes) behavior is OUT OF SCOPE / deferred for this deliverable (see out_of_scope and REQ-GEMM-020).
parameters.constraints: 0 or 1; only 0 (single buffer) is implemented/supported this deliverable

clocks.name: clk
clocks.description: Single system clock. All sequential logic on posedge clk.

resets.name: rst_n
resets.sync_async: SYNCHRONOUS active-low reset (RESOLVED-001, RTL Director). Sampled on posedge clk.
resets.description: Primary reset. On assertion, all state elements return to reset values (see reset_behavior).

ports.name: clk
ports.description: System clock.

ports.name: rst_n
ports.description: Active-low reset (see resets).

ports.name: start
ports.description: Single-cycle pulse to begin a GEMM tile operation once weights and config are loaded (RESOLVED-002).

ports.name: cfg_mode
ports.description: RESERVED / ignored input (RESOLVED-002). FSM auto-sequences on last markers; cfg_mode is not decoded in this deliverable.

ports.name: w_load_valid
ports.description: Weight-load stream valid.

ports.name: w_load_ready
ports.description: Weight-load stream ready (backpressure to source).

ports.name: w_load_data
ports.description: One INT8 weight per accepted beat, written into weight buffer in load order (row-major linear addr=k*N+j; RESOLVED-003).

ports.name: w_load_last
ports.description: Marks the final weight beat of a full weight-buffer load (N*N weights). INFORMATIONAL only: load completion is count-governed by N*N=64 accepted beats, not by w_load_last (RESOLVED-003).

ports.name: a_in_valid
ports.description: Activation input stream valid.

ports.name: a_in_ready
ports.description: Activation input stream ready (backpressure). Outputs 0 in reset and outside COMPUTE phase (RESOLVED-008).

ports.name: a_in_data
ports.description: One column vector of N INT8 activations per accepted beat feeding the array. Packing: element i in bits [i*8 +: 8]. Output-stationary parallel-broadcast MAC, no inter-PE skew (RESOLVED-004/010/011).

ports.name: a_in_last
ports.description: Marks final activation beat of the streamed K dimension for the current tile.

ports.name: y_out_valid
ports.description: Requantized output stream valid.

ports.name: y_out_ready
ports.description: Downstream ready (backpressure into the tile).

ports.name: y_out_data
ports.description: One row of N INT8 requantized results per accepted beat during drain. Packing: element i in bits [i*8 +: 8].

ports.name: y_out_last
ports.description: Marks final output beat of the drained result tile.

ports.name: req_scale
ports.description: Requantization multiplier applied to each 32-bit accumulator before shift/clip. UNSIGNED 16-bit (RESOLVED-006).

ports.name: req_shift
ports.description: Requantization arithmetic right-shift amount applied after multiply. Round-to-nearest: add (1<<(shift-1)) when shift>0, then arithmetic >>> shift (RESOLVED-006).

ports.name: busy
ports.description: High while FSM is not IDLE (operation in progress). busy = (state != IDLE) (RESOLVED-005).

ports.name: done
ports.description: Single-cycle pulse asserted after the final drain beat is accepted (RESOLVED-005).

ports.name: overflow
ports.description: STICKY flag set on requant saturation/clip; cleared by reset and by an IDLE-qualified start that initiates a new load (RESOLVED-007). Accumulator wrap does NOT set this flag.

interfaces.name: weight_load_if
interfaces.description: Loads INT8 weights into the local weight buffer, one weight per accepted beat. Transfer occurs when w_load_valid && w_load_ready both high on posedge clk.

interfaces.name: activation_in_if
interfaces.description: Streams activation vectors into the array during the compute phase. Transfer when a_in_valid && a_in_ready.

interfaces.name: result_out_if
interfaces.description: Streams requantized INT8 results out during drain phase. Transfer when y_out_valid && y_out_ready.

interfaces.name: control_status_if
interfaces.description: Discrete control (start op, mode) and status (busy/done/overflow) signals.

interfaces.name: requant_if
interfaces.description: Scale and shift used by the requantize-and-clip stage. Expected stable during the drain phase.

handshake_protocol.semantics: All three streaming interfaces use valid/ready handshaking. A beat transfers on the rising edge of clk when both valid and ready are asserted. Data/last must be held stable by the producer while valid is asserted and until the beat is accepted.
handshake_protocol.backpressure: A consumer deasserting ready must stall the producer without data loss. Specifically: (a) tile deasserts a_in_ready when the activation FIFO is full or FSM not in compute phase; (b) tile deasserts w_load_ready when weight buffer full or FSM not in load phase; (c) tile holds y_out_valid and y_out_data stable when downstream deasserts y_out_ready.
handshake_protocol.valid_stability_rule: Once valid is asserted it must remain asserted (with stable payload) until the corresponding beat is accepted; valid must not be dependent combinationally on ready in a way that creates a valid<->ready combinational loop (recommend valid not derived from ready).

effects: busy deasserted (0), done deasserted (0), overflow flag cleared (0).
All output-stream signals deasserted: y_out_valid=0, y_out_last=0; y_out_data value undefined/dont-care while valid low.
All ready outputs deasserted (w_load_ready=0, a_in_ready=0). Ready outputs are 0 in reset and outside their phase (RESOLVED-008).
Activation input FIFO emptied (read/write pointers cleared).
Weight buffer contents NOT force-cleared on reset; only the loaded/valid flag is cleared (RESOLVED-009).
Weight-buffer-valid / loaded flag cleared to 0 (a fresh weight load is required after reset).

fsm_phases.description: Waiting. busy=0. Accepts entry into weight-load or waits for start. Activation FIFO is flushed on entry to IDLE (robustness fix, see NOTE-FIFO-FLUSH).

Accept weights over weight_load_if until N*N=64 weights loaded (count-governed; w_load_last informational). busy=1. Activation FIFO is flushed on entry to LOAD_WEIGHTS (robustness fix, see NOTE-FIFO-FLUSH). Single-buffer: mutually exclusive with COMPUTE.

Stream activations over activation_in_if; PEs perform INT8 MAC into 32-bit accumulators using output-stationary parallel-broadcast (no inter-PE skew), FIXED K=N=8, single pass; accumulators cleared before COMPUTE. Continues until a_in_last / K exhausted.
Requantize each accumulator (scale, shift, clip to INT8) and emit results over result_out_if honoring backpressure until y_out_last.

functional_requirements.text: Each PE shall compute a signed INT8 x INT8 multiply and accumulate the product into a signed ACC_W (32-bit) accumulator, implementing output-stationary MAC across the streamed K dimension.
functional_requirements.source: IN SCOPE: NxN PE array output-stationary INT8 MAC with 32-bit accumulation.

functional_requirements.text: For a complete tile, the accumulator for output position (i,j) shall equal acc[i][j] += a_k[i]*W[k][j] summed over k (output-stationary parallel-broadcast), i.e. C = A*B, FIXED K=N=8, single pass, accumulators cleared before COMPUTE, matching a bit-exact software INT8 reference model (RESOLVED-004/010/011).
functional_requirements.source: Representative tile of QKV/FFN projection matmul; MAC correctness.

functional_requirements.text: Multiply results shall be sign-extended to ACC_W before accumulation so no precision is lost within the 32-bit accumulator range for supported K.
Accumulation shall use ACC_W=32-bit signed arithmetic. On overflow of the 32-bit signed range the accumulator WRAPS (two's complement) and does NOT set the overflow flag (RESOLVED-007).

The requant stage shall compute out = clip( (acc * req_scale + round) >>> req_shift, -128, 127 ) for each accumulator, where req_scale is UNSIGNED 16b, round = (1<<(req_shift-1)) when req_shift>0 else 0, and >>> is an arithmetic right shift; no zero-point/bias (RESOLVED-006).
functional_requirements.source: Output accumulator array with requantization/scale-and-clip to INT8.

functional_requirements.text: Requant clipping shall saturate values above +127 to +127 and below -128 to -128 (symmetric signed INT8 range) before output. No asymmetric/zero-point support (RESOLVED-006).
The weight buffer shall store at least N*N INT8 weights and present the correct weight to each PE for the computation. Load order is row-major linear addr=k*N+j (RESOLVED-003).
functional_requirements.source: Local weight buffer feeding the array.

functional_requirements.text: The activation input FIFO shall buffer streamed activation beats of depth AFIFO_DEPTH and feed the array without data loss under producer bursts and internal stalls.
functional_requirements.source: activation input buffer/FIFO feeding the array.

functional_requirements.text: The control FSM shall sequence phases IDLE -> LOAD_WEIGHTS -> COMPUTE -> DRAIN -> IDLE, and shall not begin COMPUTE before a full weight buffer is loaded, nor DRAIN before compute completes.
functional_requirements.source: Control FSM sequencing weight-load -> stream -> drain/output phases.

functional_requirements.text: busy shall be asserted whenever the FSM is not in IDLE and deasserted in IDLE (RESOLVED-005).
done shall be a single-cycle pulse asserted after the final output beat is accepted (y_out_last accepted) (RESOLVED-005).
Weight-load interface shall transfer one INT8 weight per beat when w_load_valid && w_load_ready, and shall not accept weights outside the LOAD_WEIGHTS phase (w_load_ready held low otherwise).
Activation input interface shall transfer one beat when a_in_valid && a_in_ready, only accepting during COMPUTE phase and only when the FIFO can hold the beat.
Result output interface shall assert y_out_valid with stable y_out_data during DRAIN and hold both stable while y_out_ready is low; a beat transfers only when y_out_valid && y_out_ready.
The tile shall correctly stall (apply backpressure) on all three streams without dropping or duplicating data when the counterpart deasserts ready/valid.

On rst_n asserted, the design shall enter the reset state defined in reset_behavior (FSM IDLE, accumulators 0, FIFO empty, status flags 0, weight-loaded flag cleared; weight SRAM contents NOT force-cleared per RESOLVED-009).
After reset deassertion, the tile shall require a fresh weight load before COMPUTE can produce valid results.

Top-level accelerator core module shall instantiate and wire together: PE array, weight buffer, activation FIFO, accumulator+requant stage, and control FSM, exposing the documented top-level port list.
The design shall be synthesizable/simulatable Verilog-2001/SystemVerilog parseable by Verilator and iverilog (no vendor-specific or non-synthesizable constructs in RTL).
functional_requirements.source: Target Verilog-2001/SystemVerilog that Verilator and iverilog can parse.

functional_requirements.text: Single-buffer mutual-exclusion (ENABLE_DOUBLE_BUFFER=0) is REQUIRED and implemented: LOAD_WEIGHTS and COMPUTE are mutually-exclusive FSM phases and weight load and compute do not overlap. Double-buffer mode (ENABLE_DOUBLE_BUFFER=1, loading the next weight set while the current tile computes) is OUT OF SCOPE / deferred for this deliverable and is NOT implemented.
functional_requirements.source: double-buffering optional; descoped per RTL Director.

timing_requirements.text: All streaming handshakes are evaluated synchronously to posedge clk; a transfer is defined to occur on the clock edge where valid and ready are both high.
PE array MAC uses output-stationary parallel-broadcast with NO inter-PE skew (RESOLVED-004); fill/drain latency is deterministic per that dataflow and reflected in output timing.
req_scale and req_shift must be stable during the DRAIN phase for a given tile; changing them mid-drain yields undefined per-beat scaling (assumption, see ASSUMPTION-003).

state_requirements.text: FSM states: IDLE, LOAD_WEIGHTS, COMPUTE, DRAIN. Illegal/unreachable state encodings shall default back to IDLE (defensive).
A weight-loaded valid flag shall track whether a complete N*N weight set is resident; cleared by reset and (single-buffer) by starting a new load.

storage_requirements.text: Weight buffer: >= N*N INT8 entries (64 for N=8), modeled as register-file/SRAM; addressable/writable during LOAD_WEIGHTS. Row-major linear addr=k*N+j (RESOLVED-003).
Activation FIFO: AFIFO_DEPTH-deep, width N*DW_ACT, standard full/empty flags gating a_in_ready and internal read. Flushed on entry to IDLE/LOAD_WEIGHTS (NOTE-FIFO-FLUSH).
Accumulator array: N*N signed 32-bit accumulators (one per output position for output-stationary).

protocol_rules.text: valid must not be withdrawn before acceptance; payload held stable while valid high.
ready may be asserted/deasserted freely; no forward-progress guarantee is required from the consumer beyond eventual acceptance.

last markers (w_load_last, a_in_last, y_out_last) delimit tile boundaries. w_load_last is informational (weight-load completion is count-governed by N*N=64 beats, RESOLVED-003); a_in_last and y_out_last are asserted on the final beat of their respective phases.

error_cases.text: Accumulator 32-bit signed overflow during accumulation: WRAPS (two's complement) and does NOT set the overflow flag (RESOLVED-007).
Requant result outside INT8 range: shall be clipped/saturated per REQ-GEMM-006 and SETS the sticky overflow flag (RESOLVED-007).
start asserted while weight buffer not fully loaded / FSM not IDLE-qualified: start is ignored and does not begin COMPUTE (RESOLVED-002/007).
More/fewer weight beats than N*N: load completion is count-governed by N*N=64 accepted beats; w_load_last is informational only (RESOLVED-003).

Activation stream shorter/longer than expected K before a_in_last: over-supplied stream residue is prevented from corrupting the next tile by FLUSHING the activation FIFO on entry to IDLE/LOAD_WEIGHTS (NOTE-FIFO-FLUSH robustness fix).
y_out_ready never asserted (permanent downstream stall): tile must hold results indefinitely without corruption (no timeout in scope).

assumptions.text: All data values are two's-complement signed INT8/INT32 unless a resolved question states otherwise.
Single clock domain; no CDC. All interfaces synchronous to clk.
req_scale/req_shift are quasi-static per tile and stable through DRAIN.
The tile computes a single NxN output tile per LOAD->COMPUTE->DRAIN cycle; larger GEMMs are tiled externally by the testbench/driver (out of scope for this module).
Data packing for vector ports is little-endian element order: element i occupies bits [i*8 +: 8].

module_breakdown.role: Top-level accelerator core: port list + instantiation/wiring of all submodules and the FSM.
Single processing element: INT8*INT8 multiply, 32-bit accumulate, register pipeline for output-stationary operation.
NxN grid of pe instances with output-stationary parallel-broadcast interconnect (no inter-PE skew).
N*N INT8 register-file/SRAM model with load-side write port and per-PE read; single buffer (double buffer out of scope).
Synchronous FIFO buffering activation input beats; full/empty flags; flushed on entry to IDLE/LOAD_WEIGHTS.
Per-output scale-multiply, arithmetic shift (round-to-nearest), and INT8 clip/saturate stage; drives sticky overflow flag.
IDLE/LOAD_WEIGHTS/COMPUTE/DRAIN sequencer generating handshake enables and status (busy/done).

traceability.source_text: NxN PE array doing output-stationary INT8 multiply-accumulate with 32-bit accumulation
Output accumulator array with a requantization/scale-and-clip stage down to INT8 (post-GEMM quantization)
activation input buffer/FIFO feeding the array
A control FSM sequencing weight-load -> stream -> drain/output phases
Basic top-level integration wiring these into one accelerator core module
Target Verilog-2001/SystemVerilog that Verilator and iverilog can parse
double-buffering optional (single-buffer required/implemented; double-buffer descoped per RTL Director)

resolved_decisions.text: Reset is SYNCHRONOUS active-low (rst_n), sampled on posedge clk.
start is a single-cycle PULSE. cfg_mode is RESERVED/ignored (not decoded); the FSM auto-sequences on last markers.
Weight load is row-major linear address addr=k*N+j, N*N=64 beats total. Load completion is COUNT-governed (64 accepted beats); w_load_last is INFORMATIONAL only.
Output-stationary parallel-broadcast MAC with NO inter-PE skew.
done is a single-cycle pulse asserted after the final drain beat is accepted. busy = (state != IDLE).
Requant: req_scale is UNSIGNED 16b; round-to-nearest by adding (1<<(shift-1)) when shift>0, then arithmetic >>> shift; clip to [-128,127]; NO zero-point.
Accumulator WRAPS on overflow (no flag). overflow is a STICKY flag set on requant saturation/clip; cleared by reset and by an IDLE-qualified start that initiates a new load (per Risk-2 fix).
ready outputs (w_load_ready, a_in_ready) drive 0 in reset and outside their respective phase.
On reset: accumulators, FIFO pointers, and loaded-flag are cleared; weight SRAM is NOT force-cleared (contents retained, only loaded flag invalidated).
Matmul orientation pinned: acc[i][j] += a_k[i]*W[k][j], i.e. C = A*B, FIXED K=N=8.
Single pass only; accumulators are CLEARED before COMPUTE. No multi-pass accumulate/clear control; K is FIXED at N=8.
The activation FIFO is FLUSHED on entry to IDLE/LOAD_WEIGHTS to prevent residue from over-supplied activation streams from corrupting the next tile (robustness fix).
